stem: Which heading structure is best for a documentation page?

options.text: One h1 for the page title, then h2 and h3 in order
options.rationale: A single h1 and ordered subheadings form a usable outline.
Flattening the outline removes the page structure.

options.text: Skip from h1 to h4 for visual size
options.rationale: Skipping levels breaks the outline for assistive technology.

options.text: Use bold paragraphs instead of headings
options.rationale: Bold text is not announced as a heading.

explanation: One h1 for the page title, then h2 and h3 in order, gives screen-reader users a navigable outline and keeps the document structure meaningful.
